name: Godot 4.x - Steamworks 1.65 - GodotSteam 4.24
body:
[For a full list of changes, please check the change-log here.](https://godotsteam.com/changelog/godot4)  In Godot 4.7.2 and 4.5.2 variants.

Available for Linux (64/ARM64), Mac, and Windows (64/32). Android ARM64 updates are temporarily paused.

Zips include the relevant Steam API .dll/.so/.dylib files.

name: Godot 4.4+ - Steamworks 1.65 - GodotSteam GDExtension 4.24
body:
[For a full list of changes, please check the change-log here.](https://godotsteam.com/changelog/gdextension/)

Works on any Godot version 4.4 and up.

Just drop the contents of this zip into the base of your project and that's it!

Available for Windows, Linux, Android ARM64, and OSX.
